info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Ecommerce Cart Checkouts-v4-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Checkout Listing API allows users to retrieve detailed information about the checkouts associated with shopping carts. This operation provides insight into the status and contents of ongoing and completed transactions. Typical consumers of this API include ecommerce platforms and inventory management systems that require real-time updates on shopping cart activities. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance customer experiences and optimize checkout processes based on immediate data access.

get.summary: Initiate the checkout process for the cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to start the checkout process for their current shopping cart. It prepares the necessary information for payment and shipping, allowing for a smooth transaction flow.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the checkout process for the items currently in the cart. It should include the necessary information to process the order.

200.description: Request completed successfully, providing the checkout details.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the cart checkout.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.title: Checkout Response

status.description: Indicates whether the checkout operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the checkout transaction.

resultId.description: The result identifier for the checkout operation.

state.description: The current state of the checkout operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the checkout operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message describing the result of the checkout operation.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.description: Represents the response for a checkout operation.
